content.title: The Amol That Removes All Worries of This World and the Hereafter.
content.subtitle: An Amol of 7 Times Daily, Guaranteed by Allah Himself.
content.body:
Life is rarely free from anxiety and distress. Family struggles, financial worries, physical illness, and uncertainty about the future constantly weigh upon our hearts. Yet, when a believer remembers that the power to resolve every difficulty rests in the hands of Allah, the heart finds a source of comfort beyond this world.

The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ taught his Ummah a beautiful supplication. By reciting it seven times every morning and evening, a believer seeks Allah's protection and entrusts all worries to Him.

A Hadith Promising Divine Protection

It is narrated from Abu Darda (RA) that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever recites this supplication seven times in the morning and evening, Allah will suffice him against whatever concerns him in this world and the Hereafter."

(Sunan Abi Dawud: 5081)

This beautiful hadith reminds us that no matter how overwhelming our worries may seem, we can always turn to Allah, the ultimate source of help, mercy, and protection.

The Supplication and Its Meaning

Reflect upon the meaning of this beautiful supplication as you recite it:

حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ

Translation: "Allah is sufficient for me. There is no deity worthy of worship except Him. In Him I place my trust, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne."

The Deeper Meaning Behind Every Phrase

  • حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ (Allah Is Sufficient for Me): These words express complete surrender and reliance upon Allah. When a believer places their trust in Him rather than depending solely on creation, they find comfort in knowing that Allah is always there.

  • لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ (There Is No Deity Except Him): Allah alone holds ultimate power and authority. No hardship can overcome His will, and every blessing comes by His permission.

  • عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ (In Him I Place My Trust): These words express a willingness to surrender our fears and uncertainties to Allah, trusting in His wisdom and perfect plan.

  • وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ (He Is the Lord of the Mighty Throne): Allah is the Lord of the magnificent Throne and the entire universe. No difficulty is beyond His power, and no problem is too great for Him to resolve.

Make This Remembrance Part of Your Daily Routine

Set aside just a minute or two every morning and evening to recite this supplication seven times. More importantly, do not merely repeat the words. Reflect upon their meaning and let their message settle deep within your heart.

As you make this remembrance a regular habit, remind yourself that your worries are never greater than Allah's mercy and power. Turn to Him with sincerity, place your trust in Him, and seek His help through every difficulty.

How to Practise This Remembrance on the Muslims Day App

You can easily complete this daily remembrance using the Muslims Day app:

  • Open the Muslims Day app and tap Dua in the bottom menu.

  • Select Morning and Evening Adhkar.

  • Find this blessed supplication along with other important authentic morning and evening adhkar, complete with audio.

Make this simple yet meaningful remembrance part of your everyday life. May Allah ease our worries, strengthen our faith, and grant our hearts lasting peace in this world and the Hereafter. Ameen.
